# Noji

> > Noji is a flashcards and spaced repetition study app used by over 7 million learners for exam preparation, language learning, and active recall mastery.

The platform combines scientifically-proven spaced repetition algorithms with pre-made decks and custom flashcard creation, helping students and lifelong learners optimize their study sessions and retention.

## Key Topics

- Flashcards
- Spaced repetition
- Active recall
- Study app
- Language learning
- Exam preparation
- Pre-made decks
- Memory retention
- Learning optimization
- Educational technology
- Sam Makka
- Custom flashcards
- Study efficiency
